issue.title: Reconcile ACE PNG snapshot baseline drift
issue.description: Discovered while verifying an unrelated agent-family module split. The full just test run produced broad ACE PNG snapshot mismatches, and representative failures reproduce in isolation: agents_renamed_generic_family_root_120x40 differs by 13.20% changed pixels and config_center_config_tab_120x40 differs by 4.67%. The refactor's focused 198 status tests pass and the Config Center mismatch is outside its scope. Diagnose the shared visual baseline/runtime drift and update code, renderer setup, or goldens as appropriate; do not accept snapshots without confirming the changes are intentional.

payload.close_reason: Let's see if this continues to cause issues.

evidence.note: Independent recurrence during unrelated commit_publication module split verification on 2026-08-03: full just check and a focused just test-visual rerun both failed config_center_agent_clis_marked_120x40 (0.670357% changed pixels) and config_center_agent_clis_update_preview_120x40 (0.281415%). No Config Center or visual code changed. Exact same pair and ratios were also reported by sase-en.2.

Independent recurrence during unrelated publication_outbox module split verification on 2026-08-03: full just check and a focused just test-visual rerun both failed config_center_agent_clis_marked_120x40 (0.670357% changed pixels) and config_center_agent_clis_update_preview_120x40 (0.281415%). No Config Center or visual code changed; 27 focused publication-outbox/publication-lane tests pass, and all lint/type/size checks pass.

Independent recurrence during unrelated epic-launch sync-lock implementation on 2026-08-03: full just check failed only after pytest reached 25,824 passes / 7 skips with config_center_agent_clis_marked_120x40 (0.670357% changed pixels) and config_center_agent_clis_update_preview_120x40 (0.281415%). The two exact visual nodes also failed through '.venv/bin/python tools/run_pytest visual ... -vv' with the same ratios, while the sync-lock targeted tests and the epic-summary setup errors pass after local fixes. No Config Center or visual code changed in this work.

Independent reproduction on 2026-08-03 during an unrelated plugins-browser module split: full just check and serial focused reruns failed only config_center_agent_clis_marked_120x40 (0.670357%) and config_center_agent_clis_update_preview_120x40 (0.281415%) among the browser snapshots. The rendered actuals are byte-for-byte identical to the pre-f4acb7918 goldens (blob IDs 45aa45b6b84896bb757c24945e336b75f848fcf7 and ff38fe77e0ac44ace914e35789d9bd12b8761fa4). Commit cd9815ff6 changed the fixture default to history-enabled; f4acb7918 then replaced these two goldens with history-hidden images without changing that default. All 147 focused non-visual plugin-browser tests pass, confirming stale goldens rather than refactor behavior drift.

Independent recurrence during unrelated _registry_scan module split verification on 2026-08-03: full just check and a focused 1-worker just test-visual rerun both failed config_center_agent_clis_marked_120x40 (0.670357%) and config_center_agent_clis_update_preview_120x40 (0.281415%). The marked-update actual shows the update-history panel instead of the golden's CLI detail panel. No Config Center or visual code changed; all 22 focused registry rebuild tests pass.

Independent recurrence during the unrelated timezone-display test-file split on 2026-08-03: full just check and focused just test-visual rerun both failed config_center_agent_clis_marked_120x40 (0.670357% changed pixels) and config_center_agent_clis_update_preview_120x40 (0.281415%). All 45 moved timezone tests pass, all static gates pass, and no Config Center or visual code changed.
